title: The Barred Archive
subtitle: Ash in the Vaults
summary: Hired arsonists target the duplicate ledgers in the Archive Room; Ilvar, Nova, and Torrik defend the harbor registers.

c7_start.speaker: torrik
c7_start.text: Orsen's wagons are rolling south with Haldor's escort. We rode back into the ward just in time—someone broke the Archive side shutter!

c7_archive_smoke.speaker: ilvar
c7_archive_smoke.text: Keep that bucket moving, Nova! They tipped the oil lamp into the lower tax shelves before we bolted the oak door!

c7_vault_choice.speaker: torrik
c7_vault_choice.text: Sparks crawl toward the eastern shelf holding the stamped harbor barge registers while the corridor door shudders under iron bars.

choices.label: Drag the heavy iron-bound harbor registers out through the barred window chute
Hold the corridor door shut with Ilvar while letting the outer shelves burn

c7_vault_saved.speaker: ilvar
c7_vault_saved.text: Not a single harbor stamp lost. Watch bells are ringing—those hired thugs fled down the stairs empty-handed.

c7_vault_partial.speaker: ilvar
c7_vault_partial.text: We held the door, though half the eastern shelf turned to ash. At least we still have your field notebook and the lockhouse book.

c7_hq_aftermath.speaker: fennick
c7_hq_aftermath.text: An unfortunate lamp accident, Archivist! Still, the elders will never condemn a Quartermaster while armed caravans hold the mountain pass.

c7_nova_end.speaker: nova
c7_nova_end.text: He just confessed his hand. Fennick's hired convoy is crossing the mountain pass right now—and Rowan's picket stands directly in their path.
